messages:
DeployBot: ALERT: embeddings-service v4.0.0 rollout in eu-west encountered sustained mem-growth on hostpool eu-embed-2. Auto-rollback attempted but blocked by change-window lock. 
Lina Park: saw the spike on dashboards. Why was the change-window locked?
SRE Pager: maintenance lock from 1791238000 — ops scheduled infra kernel updates. That prevented automated rollback job from acquiring the lock.
Ops Raj: I can perform a manual revert but need release manager sign-off to override the maintenance lock.
Product Nora: customer-impact risk assessment: EU hosted customers may see degraded embeddings for ~10-15m if we wait. Recommend manual revert for embeddings only.
CS Miguel: flagged two paying customers in eu region. They prefer immediate revert. I'll update them once we coordinate.
Release Manager Priya: emergency change window override granted. +1 for manual rollback of embeddings-service to v3.9.7 in eu-west. Keep other services at v4.0.0.
Lina Park: plan: (A) Ops run targeted image revert on eu-embed pool (B) deploybot suppression for embeddings in eu for 30m (C) add rollback annotation and pin for tracking (D) postmortem owner assigned.
Ops Raj: running commands now (one host at a time):
```
# switch image on eu pool
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/embeddings-service embeddings=redwood/embeddings:v3.9.7 --context=eu-west
# mark rollback
kubectl annotate deploy/embeddings-service rollback=1791239999 --context=eu-west
# add pin to release metadata
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_API" -d '{"release":"v4.0.0","action":"pin","tag":"rollback-1791239999","reason":"mem regression eu-west"}' https://internal-release.redwood/api/releases/pins
```
Ops Raj: rolling update started, progressing at one pod per 40s.
SRE Pager: monitoring: OOMs stopped after first two pods replaced. p95 latency returning to baseline. Continuing to watch GC churn.
DeployBot: MANUAL ACTION recorded: override-rollback by Ops Raj at 1791240025. Automated rollback suppressed due to maintenance lock earlier.
Eran (oncall): good catch. Please wait for 3 consecutive stable minutes before lifting suppression.
Product Nora: I'll draft a short blurb for release notes and customer comms: "Targeted rollback of embeddings in EU due to memory regression from v4.0.0; automated rollback blocked by maintenance lock, ops performed manual revert to v3.9.7."
CS Miguel: sent customers update. They acknowledged and asked for ETA on next safe upgrade.
Lina Park: created JIRA RED-4521 to track root cause (likely quant-kv GC interaction) and to schedule a canary with kernel-metrics enabled. Assigned to SRE + Runtime team.
Release Manager Priya: updating release notes and tagging the release with rollback-1791239999. Also disabling the v4.0.0 auto-rollout for embeddings in EU for 24h.
Ops Raj: eu-west rollout finished at 1791240298. All pods now at v3.9.7.
SRE Pager: p95 stable, no new OOMs. We'll keep an elevated watch for 2 hours.
Lina Park: postmortem: I'll own immediate write-up; include timeline, lock analysis, and runbook update to allow automated rollback even during infra maintenance with explicit override rules.
DeployBot: NOTE: system suppressed auto-rollouts for embeddings in eu-west for 1800s to avoid flip-flop.
Eran (oncall): closing loop here. If anything else pops, call 1-pager and we'll escalate. :thumbsup:
